description: Add a comment to an incident, firing or resolved: what you found, a link, the commit that fixes it, what you ruled out. Markdown, at most 4000 characters (longer is refused, not cut). It is stored on the incident and shows in the incident sheet with your name and the time, and every one is written to the operator log. Comment as you learn things; a comment is the right place for findings, links and fix commits.

by.description: Who is doing this, as "agent: <who>", for example "agent: claude in web-app". Required: it is shown on the tile, in the incident sheet and in History. "agent: " is added when left off. At most 64 characters.

key.description: The incident key exactly as watch_state or list_incidents print it ("<service>|<rule>", or "<service>|<rule>|<instance>" for a rule split per instance). Not an alert key.

text.description: The comment, markdown, at most 4000 characters.

name: comment
title: Comment on an incident
